blocks.content: Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code
Here is the full breakdown of how SpeedBlip's build was sequenced:

items: Chunk 1 - Project setup: Yarn + TypeScript + Vite, Tailwind tokens, folder structure, React Router scaffold
Chunk 2a - Navigation system: Sidebar (desktop), BottomNav (mobile), AppLayout wrapper
Chunk 2b - Landing page: Hero, how it works, features, FAQ, CTA, footer
Chunk 3 - Speed test engine: Cloudflare API, Web Worker, localStorage, useSpeedTest hook
Chunk 4 - Dashboard page: Speed gauge, stat cards, live line chart, status banner
Chunk 5 - History page: Date filters, speed chart, data table, CSV export
Chunk 6 - Settings page: Threshold inputs, notification toggle, data management controls
Chunk 7 - Polish: PWA manifest, SEO meta tags, Framer Motion page transitions, error boundary, 404 page, accessibility

blocks.content: Notice the pattern: infrastructure first, then navigation, then pages from simplest to most complex, then features on top of those pages, then polish last. Each layer builds on the one before it.

blocks.alt: Vertical timeline of 7 chunks, each labeled with its scope and showing a git commit badge at the end. Chunks are grouped: Setup (1), Navigation + Landing (2a, 2b), Engine (3), Pages (4, 5, 6), Polish (7)
